title: Astrid and the Cover
author: Zephyrine Montrose
blurb: Gideon Okafor, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
